$schema_note: Phase 50A R3 — the FIXED, CHECKED-IN SCAN SET OF ONE SUITE: tests/phase-50a/no-leak-and-neutrality.test.ts. This file is DATA, not code. Its authority is exactly that suite's read/scan set and NOTHING ELSE: it is the single declaration of the paths that suite scans, so the suite restates no path and cannot widen its own input set (scripts/phase-50a/proof-input-manifest.mjs#readManifestInput refuses an undeclared read). It is NOT a declaration of the inputs to the build, the typecheck, the repository-wide test run, control-plane validation or the control-plane tests, the fixtures, the generated declarations, package pruning, the C1-C9 artifact verification, or the remote proof workflow — and nothing derives trigger, proof, or input completeness from it. The workflow's pull_request trigger is UNCONDITIONAL (no paths, no paths-ignore), so trigger completeness is a property of that trigger and needs no enumeration; tests/phase-50a/workflow-trigger-contract.test.ts pins it. There is NO exception mechanism of any kind — not a renamed one, not an empty one.
